title: zanthoxylum rubescens var. dispermum
intro: Zanthoxylum rubescens var. dispermum, commonly known as the wild pepper, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum rubescens var. dispermum include analgesic, antipyretic, and diaphoretic effects, making it a valuable treatment for fever, pain, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as rutin, quercetin, and kaempferol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
